The functionality embedded in the main body of the app includes only event list and monthly calendar views.

・Next 3 Events Display:
Displays the next 3 synced events from iPhone, optionally including all-day events.

Displays the current month's calendar, optionally starting with Monday.

Monthly calendars view allows:
・Scroll to view calendars for the previous month, current month, and next 3 months.
・Double tap to switch between starting on Sunday or Monday.
・Long tap to scroll to the current month.

*Notes:
・Corner complications, circular complications, and large rectangular complications operate on Apple Watch Series 4 and later. Therefore, CalCs does not guarantee operation on Series 3 and earlier models.

・Due to watchOS complications update restrictions, there may be delays in updates after changes like adding or editing events on iPhone.

・It may take considerable time from placing complications for them to appear.

・If complications do not update, launching CalCs via complication tap might trigger an update. Please try this if needed.
